properties.description: When an agent makes a consequential recommendation — a decision the person will act on, a cause pinned down, a choice settled — the served instructions say to record it as an inference chain (add_inference) with premises the person can point at, a rule, and a conclusion. Ordinary remarks stay prose. The chain is the agent's stated argument, made so every step can be checked; it is not a transcript. Said where the agent's hands are: in the loop (AGENTS.md step 1), and in the three skills that produce the most consequential recommendations (root-cause step 8, brainstorm step 5, capture-intent step 2).
properties.name: The served instructions (AGENTS.md, root-cause, brainstorm, capture-intent) tell an agent to record a consequential recommendation as an inference chain
